newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian govt criticises petrol price increases.
newsitem.headline: Italian govt criticises petrol price increases.

text.p: The Italian government on Tuesday called recent rises in domestic petrol prices excessive and demanded a meeting with the head of Italy's oil industry body, Unione Petrolifera.
"In response to the recent action by petrol companies on prices, the government believes these rises are unjustified," the government said in a statement, released after a cabinet meeting.
"(It) believes that the trend and current excessive level of prices are without parallel in the European Union."
The statement said Prime Minister Romano Prodi would meet Unione Petrolifea president, Pasquale De Vita, to discuss the problem on Tuesday.
Petrol firms have been swift to push up pump prices in response to recent dollar gains, with the price of four star petrol now at a record high of 1,935 lire per litre.
